brief: Three approaches to mesh face manipulation: basic surface meshing, mesh joining from multiple surfaces, and advanced face culling with random reduction and mesh explosion/recombination
context: Three definition blocks. Top-left: Surface feeds Divide Surface (Count=2), Points to Construct Mesh producing Mesh (V:6 F:5), then Unify Mesh. Top-right: Multiple Surfaces feed Mesh components, Mesh Join produces Mesh (V:28 F:8), CombineAndClean produces Mesh (V:18 F:8) showing vertex welding. Bottom: Surface feeds Mesh Surface (V Count=11), Deconstruct Mesh extracts Vertices/Faces/Colours/Normals. Cull Index removes face at index 0, Cull Pattern (0,0;1,1) and Random Reduce (70%) filter faces. Mesh Explode with List Item selects individual faces. Results go through CombineAndClean and Mesh Join.
category: Expert - Mesh Operations and Digital Fabrication

solution_principle: Mesh manipulation requires understanding vertex-face relationships. Culling, reducing, and exploding faces while maintaining vertex integrity is key to custom mesh editing workflows.
